info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Carrental Reservations Modify-v4-spec
info.description: This API allows businesses to modify existing car rental reservations, ensuring that customers' needs are met efficiently. Users can update details such as rental dates, vehicle types, and customer information to enhance service flexibility. Typical consumers of this API include car rental service providers and applications managing reservations for end users. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline operations and improve customer satisfaction through timely updates and management of car rentals.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to make changes to an existing reservation, including updating details such as date, time, and number of guests. Ensure that the reservation ID is provided to identify which reservation to modify.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to modify existing reservations. Ensure all required fields are provided for optimal processing.

200.description: The reservation has been modified successfully.
